title: Lesson 8.1: DeFi portfolio construction

scenes.vo: Lesson eight point one. DeFi portfolio construction.

scenes.sub: Split capital into risk buckets with caps, so no single failure can sink the portfolio.
scenes.vo: Split capital into risk buckets with caps, so no single failure can sink the portfolio.
scenes.cap: Split capital into risk buckets with caps, so no single failure can sink the portfolio.

scenes.title: Key ideas
scenes.vo: Buckets: liquidity reserve , core (simple, durable) , productive (L.P., vaults, carry) , speculative (new, points, experiments). Concentration caps: per protocol, per chain, per stablecoin issuer, per bridge. Genuine diversification: two front ends on the same protocol, or two stablecoins with the same backing, are one risk, not two. Rebalancing rules: thresholds that trigger moving money between buckets.
scenes.cap: Buckets: liquidity reserve · core (simple, durable) · productive (LP, vaults, carry) · speculative (new, points, experiments). Concentration caps: per protocol, per chain, per stablecoin issuer, per bridge. Genuine diversification: two front ends on the same protocol, or two stablecoins with the same backing, are one risk, not two. Rebalancing rules: thresholds that trigger moving money between buckets.
